independent_statistics_method.bootstrap: 20,000 exact empirical multinomial whole-group draws reconstructed from independent difference-support counts, frozen seed string and SHA256 seed derivation; NumPy default_rng; linear quantiles at [.025,.975] and [.05/12,1-.05/12].
independent_statistics_method.bounds: Every known individual error retained across all3,000 groups; each missing error independently ranged over[0,1] with signed half-weights.
independent_statistics_method.matched_comparisons: Independent pair-specific shared valid cohorts on locked500 main groups and1,000 external IDs, exact class counts/cohort hashes/mean differences/seeded95% intervals.
independent_statistics_method.native_parsing: Extracted Jev noul and Luna predicate probabilities directly from response.raw; exact0.5 abstains; predictions above0.5 are attack; compared all retained parses and pinned returned models.
independent_statistics_method.primary_cohort: The identical intersection of valid first outputs across both native models, four conditions and two pages.
independent_statistics_method.state_integrity: Strict independent final event hash/index/previous-hash verification plus read-only BudgetLedger._apply state replay; all48,000 primary completed files linked to terminal ledger evidence; every recorded primary raw artifact byte-verified.
independent_statistics_method.tests: Independent scipy.stats.ttest_1samp on raw-reconstructed group differences and separate Holm step-down arithmetic over six tests; no production analysis statistic functions invoked.
independent_statistics_method.unit: Original clean/attack source group; equal weight per group.

primary_raw_artifact_integrity.scope: Every recorded primary raw_hashes artifact now byte-verified across this pass and prior raw-score reconstruction; request model/payload/first namespace exact.

primary_reconstruction.method: Raw native probability extraction plus locked source labels; no production analysis functions called. Independent SciPy one-sample t and documented seeded empirical multinomial bootstrap.

qualifications: Results measure static agreement with original benchmark construction labels; they do not establish agent task completion or prevention of attacks.
The shared primary cohort is2,850 of3,000 planned groups. All48,000 native calls being terminal is a collection count, not the primary statistical N.
Complete-case estimates condition on valid first outputs and need not generalize to missing groups. All-planned known-error bounds are finite-cohort extrema, not confidence intervals.
Reported percentile bootstrap intervals are approximate population uncertainty procedures; exact reconstruction of the empirical bootstrap calculation does not make their population coverage exact.

On the shared cohort, Jev task information lowers balanced error against all three controls but trades fewer clean-page false positives for more attack-page false negatives. Luna Decisions has higher balanced error with task information against each control.

Paid Responses confirmation has109 valid outputs and2 credit failures among4,000 planned main cells; remaining cells are unattempted. Paid Luna external and later repeats, and Sol confirmation/repeats, are not a completed comparator panel.
Jev external collection contains4,000 attempts, including10 ties; valid classification N is3,990. Native tie scores remain available in score diagnostics.

Repeat-1 outputs remain separate and never replace primary first attempts. All800 actual repeat calls are Jev; this is not complete repetition coverage across all models.
